reference.title: Scenario 3: Keywords metadata
reference.shortdesc: Consider an index.md file with front matter and a keywords field and multiple values listed

section.p: Consider an index.md file with front matter and a keywords field and multiple values listed as keywords.

entry.codeblock: +++ title = "Alarm Notifier" description = "Configure and manage alarm notifications." keywords = ["alarms","notifications","monitoring"] +++

<prolog> <metadata> <keywords> <keyword>alarms</keyword> <keyword>notifications</keyword> <keyword>monitoring</keyword> </keywords> </metadata> </prolog> <title>Alarm Notifier</title> <shortdesc> Configure and manage alarm notifications. </shortdesc>

section.p: Result:The keyword values are added inside the metadata element of the DITA file as keyword elements. They improve search and metadata quality.
